اقتبسن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَسْنَ (iqtabasna) /iq.ta.bas.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)

# اِقْتَبِسْنَ (iqtabisna) /iq.ta.bis.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
